reviews.title: Great functionality, very satisfying mouse!!
reviews.comment: Just got this mouse today and already love it. Extremely smooth, love the hand feel and materials. The forward/back buttons on thumb are awesome, and love the hidden thumb button. Wireless bluetooth connectivity is seamless for my Mac and the logitech app is great for integrating multiple product and customizing function. Scroll wheel has the infinite scroll option which I was missing on my previous mice. Everything about this mouse is satisfying and I like its simplistic/clean look compared to more expensive complex models. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sterling

reviews.title: A Solid and Accurate Performer
reviews.comment: Solid and comfortable to hold, this mouse is exactly what I needed for the desktop. So much bigger than the tiny laptop mouse. Has plenty of useful functions. So far, the accuracy and speed are excellent. Haven't experience much lag time, if any, while connected by Bluetooth. It quickly found and connected to Bluetooth after adding it to Bluetooth devices on Windows 11.  It comes with the "Unifier" (old version dongle)... not the latest, "Bolt", so you may want to keep that in mind.  It won't connect to the Bolt. The noise level seems a bit quieter than many other mice on the market. Having Logi Options+ makes setting the mouse function easy, however, there aren't many to choose from. It can be use for 3 different devices, but I only need it for the desktop. Only drawback, the scroll wheel (at times) seems pretty loose and that is a little disappointing. All and all, the M720 is a good, solid, accurate performer and I am happy with it so far. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: L. Kozak

reviews.title: Great mouse, but does not last long.
reviews.comment:
I have been using the Logitech M720 Triathlon mouse for about 1.5 years now, and overall, it has been a reliable companion for my daily tasks. One of the standout features that I absolutely love about this mouse is its Flow functionality, which allows me to seamlessly switch between multiple devices with just a flick of the scroll wheel. It has made my workflow much more efficient and productive.
The battery life of the M720 Triathlon is excellent. Even with regular use, I find that the battery lasts for an impressively long time, saving me from the hassle of frequent recharging or changing batteries. It's a great convenience, especially for someone like me who often forgets to charge devices regularly.
Ergonomically, this mouse is a winner. The design fits comfortably in my hand, and the buttons are well-placed, making it easy to use for extended periods without causing strain or discomfort. It's also relatively lightweight, which further adds to its ergonomic appeal.
However, my main gripe with the Logitech M720 Triathlon mouse is that it started double-clicking on its own after about 1.5 years of use. This issue has become increasingly frustrating as it affects my accuracy and efficiency while working. I've tried cleaning the mouse and changing the settings, but the problem persists. This is disappointing considering the overall positive experience I had with the mouse before this flaw surfaced.
In summary, the Logitech M720 Triathlon mouse has some fantastic features, such as the Flow functionality, impressive battery life, and ergonomic design, which greatly enhance my computing experience. However, the unfortunate issue of double-clicking that emerged after 1.5 years of use significantly dampened my overall satisfaction with this mouse. I would recommend the M720 Triathlon for its strengths, but potential buyers should be aware of the possibility of encountering the double-clicking problem in the long run.
